title: data-agent-traces: code for "What Agent Traces Do Not Record: Harness Effects and Data-Reference Errors in Code-Writing LLM-based Agents for Data Analysis"
description: Trace parsers for DABstep and DataAgentBench; an exact pre-execution checker for the column, key and file names in agent-written Python, in four releases with their hashes and tests; and the scripts that rebuild the per-step records from the public data at pinned commits and print the counts in the preprint. For each pre-registered study, the controlled DataAgentBench reruns and the live experiments on QRData, the repository holds the plan, amendments, runner, analysis and per-run results; the per-run records of the DataAgentBench reruns contain no agent code, answers or benchmark data. It also holds the hand audit's sample, codebook and three coders' labels, with the human labels of the check of DataAgentBench's failure-analysis judge. The repository contains no benchmark data; the scripts download each dataset at a pinned commit.
